plan.name: Marathon Training: Novice Supreme
plan.author: Hal Higdon
plan.description: A 12-week novice base block followed by 18 weeks of Novice 1 marathon training.

meta.target_audience: New runners with time to build a base before marathon training

cross_training.label: Cross Training
cross_training.description: A non-running aerobic session used to maintain fitness while reducing running impact.

easy_run.label: Easy Run
easy_run.description: An easy aerobic run done at a comfortable, conversational pace to build endurance while limiting fatigue.

long_run.label: Long Run
long_run.description: Run at a comfortable effort unless the workout includes a specific pace cue.

rest.label: Rest
rest.description: A no-training day used to absorb prior workouts and promote recovery.

walk.label: Walk
walk.description: Walk at an easy pace unless a brisk effort is prescribed.

coaching_guidance.text: Start with the 12-week Novice Base Training schedule, then follow the 18-week Novice 1 marathon schedule.

source.page_title: Novice Supreme Marathon Training Program | Hal Higdon
